title: Support Inbox → AI Triage → Route, Draft, Escalate

sections.label: 1 · INTAKE
sections.note: Every inbound support email lands here and is stripped to the parts that matter — sender, subject, body, and any prior thread history — before classification.

sections.label: 2 · TRIAGE
sections.note: One pass assigns category, urgency and sentiment, and drafts a reply. Angry customers and billing problems are detected here rather than after they have sat in a queue for six hours.

sections.label: 3 · ROUTE
sections.note: Urgent tickets page the on-call channel immediately. Routine ones get a drafted reply waiting for a human to skim and send — the agent proposes, a person still approves.

sections.label: 4 · RECORD
sections.note: Everything is written to the ticket table with its classification, so response-time and volume-by-category reporting comes for free instead of needing its own project.

input_sample.name: Tom Brennan
input_sample.subject: Re: charged twice this month??
input_sample.body: This is the second time — we got billed on the 3rd and again on the 17th for the same seat count. I need this refunded before our board meeting Friday or we're looking at alternatives.

output_sample.drafted_reply: Hi Tom — you're right, I can see two charges on the 3rd and the 17th for the same 12 seats. I've submitted the refund for the duplicate; it'll land back on the original card in 3-5 business days. I've also flagged the account so the duplicate schedule can't repeat.
